rationale: Epsilon0.01 completed all20 primary games but reached only Level4, below sampled source6. Pure argmax had a completed Level7 game but seven serve stalls. Test one predeclared lower-exploration counterpart at epsilon0.001 to assess the tradeoff; do not infer success or run an open-ended rate sweep.

method.description: At every action independently of the screen or game status, select a uniformly random one of six actions with probability0.001; otherwise choose learned policy-logit argmax.
method.source_scope: Generic epsilon-greedy evaluation is a published DQN mechanism (Mnih2015 used0.05). This is a lower-dose PPO-logit diagnostic, not a DQN replication.

launch_after: Epsilon0.01 session76360 exited0 and was audited as weaker. Both learners remain unchanged.
selection_rule: All20 games must finish GAME OVER without truncation. Compare the complete suite's descending level-reach rank against sampled f58 primary. Only a strictly stronger depth rank warrants a 50-game secondary diagnostic in exactly this same epsilon-greedy mode; no fresh final-test seeds for selection. Never relabel a result as sampled PPO or silently change the live training/validation protocol.
followup_limit: This is the only planned lower-rate counterpart. If it is not stronger than sampled Level6 primary, retain sampled decoding and continue the declared training tranches.
